2123228828172763265.en_summary: $AMZN rose 3.8% today while $META fell 0.4% and the S&P fell for a fifth straight session. $MSFT up 0.4%, $AAPL up 0.2%, $TSLA up 1.0%. The megacaps are no longer moving as one block, and the index is not the story.
2123228828172763265.zh_summary: $AMZN 今天上漲 3.8%，而 $META 下跌 0.4%，標普連續第五個交易日下跌。$MSFT 上漲 0.4%，$AAPL 上漲 0.2%，$TSLA 上漲 1.0%。大型股不再作為一個板塊移動，指數不是故事。

2123228455756272069.en_summary: $ANT starts trading tomorrow. Priced at $83, above the range, $81.3 billion raised, a valuation near $1.5 trillion. The float is only 6.3% of the shares out, and lock-ups start releasing from day one, 1.61 billion shares free by February 2. A hot open can reverse fast. The first trade is set by who wants to buy it.
2123228455756272069.zh_summary: $ANT 明天開始交易。定價 83 美元，高於區間，籌集 813 億美元，估值接近 1.5 兆美元。流通股僅占已發行股份的 6.3%，鎖定從第一天開始釋放，到 2 月 2 日將有 16.1 億股自由流通。熱開盤可能迅速反轉。第一筆交易由想買的人決定。

2123228186892751257.en_summary: $LOW beat too, adjusted EPS $3.10 against $2.86, sales $22.76B up 9.3%, and the stock fell 5% premarket before closing up 1%. The catch: 34 cents of the beat was a tariff refund, and the full-year guide was a touch weak. A beat built on a refund is not a beat the tape trusts. Housing demand is holding. The guide is the problem.
2123228186892751257.zh_summary: $LOW 也超預期，調整後 EPS 3.10 美元對比 2.86 美元，銷售額 227.6 億美元增長 9.3%，股票在盤前下跌 5% 後收盤上漲 1%。問題是超預期的 34 美分來自關稅退款，全年指引略弱。建立在退款上的超預期不是市場信任的超預期。住房需求維持。指引是問題。

ticker_notes.LOW: EPS $3.10 vs $2.86, sales +9.3%, pre -5% close +1%, tariff refund

2123228111730847911.en_summary: $TJX was the cleanest retail win of the day. Adjusted EPS $1.34, sales $15.95B, comps up 4%, and the outlook raised. The stock closed up 8%. Off-price keeps taking share while the rest of retail fights for traffic. When the guide is clean, the tape pays for it, even on a day the market fell.
2123228111730847911.zh_summary: $TJX 是當天最乾淨的零售勝利。調整後 EPS 1.34 美元，銷售額 159.5 億美元，同店銷售增長 4%，展望上調。股票收盤上漲 8%。折扣店持續搶占份額，而其他零售爭奪客流。當指引乾淨時，市場會為此買單，即使在市場下跌的一天。

2123227999961035182.en_summary: $PANW just gave the security bucket its proof point. Revenue $3.44B, up 39%, adjusted EPS $1.05 against $0.97, Next-Gen Security ARR up 66% to $9.73B, and the full-year guide raised to $14.52-14.57B. It also bought Applied Compute, an AI platform, for $4.5B in stock. The stock rose 9.9% in the regular session and another 8% after hours. AI raises the stakes for cybersecurity, and this quarter the market paid for it.
2123227999961035182.zh_summary: $PANW 剛剛為安全板塊提供了證明。收入 34.4 億美元，增長 39%，調整後 EPS 1.05 美元對比 0.97 美元，下一代安全 ARR 增長 66% 至 97.3 億美元，全年指引上調至 145.2-145.7 億美元。它還以 45 億美元股票收購了 AI 平台 Applied Compute。股票在常規交易時段上漲 9.9%，盤後再漲 8%。AI 提高了網絡安全的賭注，本季度市場為此買單。

ticker_notes.PANW: Rev $3.44B +39%, EPS $1.05, ARR +66%, bought AI for $4.5B, stock +9.9% +8% AH
